_comment: WF v10 (2026-10-04): handheld FPS weapons. A `pipeline: "direct"` class — no JS-kernel module, no validator chain, no gold rounds: setup (concept, turnaround, registration) -> Blender build (scripts/hs/run_pass.py, out/blender-hs/BUILD-DIRECT.md) -> Fable review + one polish -> function stage (scripts/hs/rig_pass.py physics.mode handheld). Only the fields the setup chain and the HS harness read are here; the kernel gate keys of classes/vehicle.json (rules, wheels, likeness, knobPriors ...) do not exist for this class. Rules for the builder: classes/weapon.md.
_frame_comment: Author frame (the vehicle convention with muzzle = nose): muzzle +z, the weapon's LEFT flank +x (the flank the concept shows), y up, y = 0 at the weapon's lowest point (magazine / grip / bipod foot), x centred on the bore plane, z centred on the overall length. Views: side = the left flank with the muzzle to the image LEFT, front = muzzle on, rear = butt on, top = plan with the muzzle to the image LEFT.
_anchor_comment: views.json anchor = the stated overall length L (side + top measure it over ~800 px); a weapon's width is 3-8 cm, too few px to fix the scale. families.table holds ONE family (body = every flat colour of the concept) so the L / W spans are the whole foreground, stock and barrel included.

concept._comment: No ground quad to solve a camera from: the concept camera is the style's fixed isometric (scripts/v7/conceptreg.mjs); scale / offset are fitted to the concept's foreground box (hull.mjs --write-frame).

gold._comment: GOLD pipeline (owner 2026-10-12: the 30 game items run gold v8, scripts/v7/gold.mjs): read ONLY for a subject whose subject.json says `pipeline: "gold"` (scripts/subject.mjs loadSubject merges this block over the class; a direct subject never sees it). No wheels / running gear / ground contact (grounded false: kernel-chain V3 load path + V4 footprint off; V4 min y = 0 kept: the frame's lowest point), one Opus critic seat per round.
gold._minFeat_comment: Hand-held min part / cut-wall size in metres (limits.json styleFloor has no weapon key and is frozen; the vehicle floor 0.04 forced hidden filler blocks and capped bevels on the SMG run). 0.008 = the smallest chunky feature the item rules keep as its own part (out/blender-hs/BUILD-DIRECT.md: grip ribs >= 8 mm, plates >= 6 mm, other visible bevels 4-10 mm, silhouette chamfers 12-20 mm): a 12-20 mm chamfer on a 30-60 mm receiver leaves >= 8 mm walls. At capture (900 px, fill 0.86, L ~0.6 m) 8 mm ~ 10 px > minFeaturePx 3.
gold.roleHint: pick the nearest real one (a top rail is "rail", a front post is "sight", a mag base plate is "magazine", a buttpad is "stock", anything else "prop")

paletteZones.for: receiver, slide, barrel shroud: the main painted / blued metal
grip, stock, handguard furniture: the moulded plastic
the concept's accent colour (stripes, emitter, coloured panel)
bare / bright steel: barrel, bolt, pins, muzzle device
recesses, bores, vents, the darkest flat colour

critics._seats: owner 2026-10-12: Opus builds and critiques; one gold-critic-opus seat per round, no Sonnet seat (gold.mjs merge works with the one critique).
